story.say: India just passed a billion internet users. But the last mile online isn't a map — it's a gender gap.
Nationally, sixty-four percent of women have used the internet — a doubling since the last survey. Men are at eighty.
On this map, darker means more women online. See the pattern.
A billion users — and the divide still runs straight through the middle of the map.

cues.text: India just passed a billion internet users. But the last mile online isn't a map — it's a gender gap.
Nationally, sixty-four percent of women have used the internet — a doubling since the last survey. Men are at eighty.
On this map, darker means more women online. See the pattern.
Goa, ninety-four percent — nearly everyone online.
Now the east. Tripura, just forty-nine percent.
Odisha, fifty-two. Half the women here have never been online.
A billion users — and the divide still runs straight through the middle of the map.
